description: This file defines the AuthRepository class that manages user authentication operations such as sign-in and sign-up. It interacts with a REST API client or provides mock data for testing purposes.

classes.name: AuthRepository
classes.description: A class responsible for handling user authentication, including sign-in and sign-up functionalities.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returning an AuthToken and User, either via mock data or by calling the backend API.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and display name, returning an AuthToken and User, either via mock data or by calling the backend API.
